1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a __thermally conductive epoxy binder__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, wherein the binder is __a premixed thermally conductive epoxy__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent __is not specifically disclosed but includes any solvent suitable for the application and removal during application to the electronic component surface__.
